## KultrDL 1.0.0

The first release: search, play, save, favourite and download music, in the Kultr look.

- **Search** YouTube Music, YouTube, Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, SoundCloud and Bandcamp from the glass search button, with albums and their track lists.
- **Open links** from Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, Qobuz, Deezer, Amazon Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and more — paste them on Home or share them to KultrDL from any app.
- **Play** in the background with notification, lock-screen and headset controls, a queue, shuffle and repeat. Downloads play offline.
- **Library:** favourites, saved tracks, playlists (your own, or saved from any album or playlist), downloads and history, with backup and restore.
- **Download as FLAC (16/24-bit), MP3 (320 kbps, V0, 256, 192, 128), AAC, Opus, ALAC, WAV or Ogg Vorbis**, with title, artist, album, track number, year, genre and cover art written into each file, saved to Music/KultrDL. Pick a default, choose per download, or be asked every time.
- **Kultr design:** liquid glass tab bar and mini player, a full-screen player you pull down to close, and colours taken from the artwork.

Audio comes from YouTube Music, YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp and other sites yt-dlp supports. Spotify, Apple Music, Deezer, Tidal, Qobuz and Amazon Music tracks play and download from their matching recording on YouTube Music, tagged with the catalogue's details. yt-dlp updates itself in Settings → Engine.

## Install

Download the APK for your phone below — **arm64-v8a** fits nearly every recent phone; **universal** fits all of them but is larger — and open it. Requires Android 8.0 or later.
